summary: The change adds a read-only approvals_remaining helper and a UI constant to payments, plus unit tests. The change ticket, independent code-review approval, and approval scope are all in order. However, the CI run was executed on the first commit (be1f9edc) rather than the head commit (ded953b1), and the second commit introduces a new code constant (PREVIEW_MIN_WIDTH = 8) that is not a comment-only, whitespace, or formatting edit. Under CHG-4 this means the testing requirement on the final commit is not met, so the change must be rejected. No product-obligation violations were found; the sole blocking issue is the missing CI run on the head commit.
